name: SCK - SALCO's COMFORT KIT
teaser: SCK brings several quality-of-life features together in one convenient package.
description_html:
About This Mod

First and foremost: This mod wouldn’t exist without the ideas from:

  • SamSwat, dirtbikerCJ, and flir’s “Time & Weather Changer”
  • Terkoiz’s “Skipper”
  • Boogles’ “Old Tarkov Movement (no inertia)”
  • netVnum’s “PAUSE”
  • Fiodor’s “Environment Volume Control”
  • Cj’s “Use Items Anywhere”
  • CWX and Kaeno’s “Trader Scrolling”

Salco’s Comfort Kit is a collection of small but useful additions for solo players on SPT 4.1.x.

It lets you adjust parts of the game that can sometimes become inconvenient without changing the entire experience around them. Most features can be adjusted through the F12 menu, allowing you to keep what you enjoy and change what you do not.

Inside the Comfort Kit you will find:

  • Time and weather controls
  • A proper in-raid pause
  • Optional old-style movement
  • Faster and more responsive leaning
  • Separate environmental volume controls
  • Task condition skipping
  • Item usage from backpacks, Secure Containers and nested containers
  • Mouse-wheel scrolling for the trader list
  • Three additional Special Slots, giving you six in total

Use the whole package or simply choose the comforts that suit you.

Time & Weather

Sometimes the perfect raid only needs the right atmosphere.

Open the Time & Weather window during a raid to change the time of day or adjust:

  • Clouds
  • Rain
  • Fog
  • Wind

You can experiment freely and return to the original weather whenever you like.

The default key is Arrow Up.

Pause

Need to answer the door, refill your drink or rescue the cat from another questionable decision?

Press Arrow Down to pause the raid. Press it again when you are ready to continue.

Simple, useful and especially welcome during longer solo raids.

Movement

The Comfort Kit offers an optional movement style inspired by the more direct feeling of older Tarkov versions.

Direction changes feel more responsive, leaning can react more quickly and aiming can still slow your movement when desired.

The movement options can be adjusted separately, so you do not have to accept an all-or-nothing preset. Find the balance that feels comfortable to you.

Task Skipping

Not every task condition remains fun forever.

While viewing your task objectives, hold Left Ctrl to reveal the available skip buttons. You decide which condition you want to move past.

Use it for a stubborn objective, an unwanted grind or simply because you would rather spend your evening doing something else.

Use Items Anywhere

Useful equipment should not become unreachable just because you packed it away neatly.

Supported items can be used or assigned to quick slots while stored inside your:

  • Pockets
  • Tactical rig
  • Backpack
  • Secure Container
  • Containers stored inside any of them

This also supports nested storage. For example, medical supplies kept inside a SICC case within your Secure Container can still be accessed.

The feature can be enabled or disabled through the F12 menu.

Trader Scrolling

Large trader lists no longer have to feel awkward to navigate.

Place your mouse over the trader row and use the Mouse Wheel to scroll sideways through the available traders.

The feature can be disabled and its scrolling speed can be adjusted through the F12 menu.

Volume Control

Keep the atmosphere without sacrificing your ears.

The following sounds can be adjusted separately:

  • Rain
  • Airdrops
  • BTR

Lower only what bothers you and leave the rest untouched.

Special Slots

Salco’s Comfort Kit adds three additional Special Slots, giving you a total of six arranged in a clean 3 × 2 layout.

This gives you a little more room for useful equipment without turning your inventory into a warehouse.

The additional slots are enabled by default but can be disabled in:

SPT_Runtime/user/mods/SalcosComfortKit/config.json

Change the following setting to false:

"enableExtendedSpecialSlots": false

Restart the SPT server after changing this setting.

Important: Empty the additional Special Slots before disabling them. Items left inside disabled slots may become inaccessible.

If Salco’s Armory is installed, it will remain responsible for the extended Special Slots. The Comfort Kit recognises this automatically and stays out of the way. SCK’s setting only controls the slots provided by SCK itself; slots provided by Salco’s Armory must be disabled through Salco’s Armory.

Custom pockets created through Server Value Modifier are also supported.

Controls
Action Default key
Open Time & Weather Arrow Up
Pause or continue the raid Arrow Down
Show task-skipping options Hold Left Ctrl
Scroll through the trader list Mouse Wheel
Open the settings menu F12

The controls and available options can be changed through the F12 menu.

Installation
  1. Download the archive.
  2. Extract its contents directly into your main SPT folder.
  3. Allow the included folders to merge.
  4. Start SPT as usual.

Open the F12 menu in-game to adjust the Comfort Kit to your liking.

REPORT BUGS

There are two ways to report bugs:

  1. My own thread on Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521957836928848032
  2. The Issues tab on GitHub: https://github.com/S4LCO/SalcosComfortKit/issues

IMPORTANT:

  1. I need a clean log.
  2. I need a list of your installed mods.

Bug reports without logs will be ignored.
